tool.description: Perl script (generateMap.pl) generates the mappability of a genome given a certain size of reads, for input to hmmcopy mapcounter. Takes a very long time on large genomes, is not parallelised at all.

tool.help:
**hmmcopy_generatemap**
Perl script (generateMap.pl) generates the mappability of a genome given a certain size of reads, for input to hmmcopy mapcounter. Takes a very long time on large genomes, is not parallelised at all.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: hmmcopy/generatemap - Container: biocontainers/hmmcopy:0.1.1--h2e03b76_7
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
